Description / Test Scenario: Verify order creation in SYNC mode (syncOnly: true)
Test Steps: 1. Send POST request with valid payload and syncOnly=true.
Expected Result: Returns 201 Created, Status: COMPLETE, and includes card/PIN details in response

Description / Test Scenario: Verify order creation in ASYNC mode (syncOnly: false)
Test Steps: 1. Send POST request with valid payload and syncOnly=false.
Expected Result: Returns 202 Accepted, Status: PROCESSING. Card details are NOT in response immediately

Description / Test Scenario: Verify physical card activation via Order API (valid cardnumber)
Test Steps: 1. Pass `cardnumber` in product array\n2. Send POST request.
Expected Result: Returns 201 Created, Status: COMPLETE indicating successful activation

Description / Test Scenario: Verify physical card activation details when activation fails via Woohoo processing
Test Steps: 1. Pass physical `cardnumber` (simulate delay/failure)\n2. Send POST request.
Expected Result: Returns 201 Created but Status: PROCESSING instead of COMPLETE

Description / Test Scenario: Verify idempotency with duplicate reference number (refno)
Test Steps: 1. Send POST request with a previously used refno.
Expected Result: Returns 400 Bad Request, code: 5313, message: 'Duplicate reference number provided'

Description / Test Scenario: Verify order creation with missing mandatory address fields
Test Steps: 1. Omit email or telephone in `address` block\n2. Send POST.
Expected Result: Returns 400 Bad Request, validation error for missing contact details

Description / Test Scenario: Verify ordering a Bank payout product type
Test Steps: 1. Include payout object (type: BANK_ACCOUNT, ifscCode, accountNumber)\n2. Send POST.
Expected Result: Returns 201/202 Order created for Bank Transfer
